tariffs.locationName: Aparcamiento de la estación de autobuses de Estella-Lizarra
tariffs.scope: two double semi-rapid municipal chargers, four charging bays

conditionalDiscounts.condition: vehicle has fiscal domicile in Estella-Lizarra and discount has been requested and authorized

tariffs.matchingPolicy: fail-closed: apply only to the municipal chargers explicitly identified as the two double chargers in the surface car park at the Estella-Lizarra bus station; do not generalize to other Navarra te recarga locations or ETECNIC-managed chargers

notes: Navarra te recarga is a shared public platform for local authorities, not a network-wide tariff authority.
The 0.30 EUR/kWh tariff must not be propagated to other municipalities using Navarra te recarga.
The 20% resident benefit is conditional and must never be treated as the public default tariff.
